title: Analytic Structures for Nonformal Deformation Quantization
exact_target: Identify the analytic ingredients that turn formal deformation quantization into an actual Hilbert- or operator-algebra theory.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002803 (OWR-13496-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Deformation quantization: between formal to strict (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/11, pp. 571--595. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 10.
Rieffel, Quantization and C*-algebras (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is a foundations programme, not a claim that every Poisson manifold admits a specified strict quantization. The desired notion of non-formal quantization must be made explicit in any proposed answer.
